summary: PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor with Anthropic API key harvesting
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt darwin/amd64 Go binary (bin/sxt) that embeds a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) and a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty), and connects to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top (plus a dynamic ws://%s:%s%s template). The network->PTY dataflow gives the remote operator interactive shell control of the installer's host. The same binary embeds the regex `sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}` together with references to `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=` and `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models`, targeting Anthropic API keys stored in the installer's Claude configuration. It also queries `http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query` for geolocation of the installer. package.json's `license` field points at `https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control`, a repository literally named `claude_control` under user `ddos798`, matching the backdoor and Claude-key-harvesting behavior in the shipped binary rather than any legitimate `sextant-cli` tool.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
